review.facts: Every factual sentence maps to a row of the merged fact key (F1-F20) in docs/assets/jet-suit/SOURCES.md. The key merges two independent AI model web fact-checks (GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash).
review.verdict: An independent read-only review of the same JSON bytes gave PUBLIC-OK for the 7 step stills and story.mp4, with hero.png excluded. That review used renders from the PR #37 head (0a53cc6dec88d0584041c69eb18357d7c314b165) before its merge.
review.differenceFromReviewedRenders: Between 0a53cc6 and this commit the only renderer change is the subtitle line (medium weight, 85 % ink, was regular 60 %). The subtitle now names jet-suit.json, not the earlier working file name. All 7 new stills were inspected one by one: labels, captions, arrows and framing match the reviewed stills. A pixel diff also shows small rendering differences in under 1.7 % of colour channels; no label, arrow or caption moved.

revisions.why: The new strict anchor check (annotation.anchor.hidden) refused the reviewed file: in step 6 the label lComb ("Combustion chamber") had its dot on the cut casing wall (back.casing was the first surface on the line of sight), not on the combustion chamber.

revisions.review: The builder inspected the new step-6.png and the story hold frames at 5.0, 32.5 and 52.0 s: the step 6 dot is inside the copper combustion chamber and the text is sharp. The independent PUBLIC-OK review above covers the earlier bytes; an independent review of PR #40 checked the moved anchor and the first replacement step-6.png.
revisions.comparison: CoreGraphics RGB comparison of each new still with the 70bfc47 still it replaces. Steps 1-5 and 7: 2,020 to 29,826 channels (0.07 % to 0.97 %) differ, by at most 11/255: render noise. Step 6: 87,577 channels (2.85 %) differ. Inside the box x 329-626, y 362-430 (the moved label, its leader and dot) they differ by up to 240/255; outside it, 55,569 channels differ by at most 22/255, spread over x 224-1277, y 3-797 (render noise and the different leader path). Two renders of this build differ by at most 2/255 in at most 64 channels per still, so the stills are not byte-reproducible.
